facts.text: We joined an all-girl band to dodge some gangsters. Tonight Osgood's buying dinner, and I'm ordering the lobster.
facts.why: Osgood invites Daphne to a champagne supper on his yacht, but Joe persuades Jerry to keep Osgood ashore and the two tango until dawn. No lobster dinner shows up in the sources read.
facts.fix: We joined an all-girl band to dodge gangsters. Osgood's asked me to his yacht for champagne, and Joe wants it more.

fix_note.text: We joined an all-girl band to dodge gangsters. Osgood's asked me to his yacht for champagne, and Joe wants it more.

facts.why: Osgood's yacht supper is cold pheasant, champagne and a herring in a jar. No lobster appears, so the dish becomes a plain millionaire's joke.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when the girls throw a party in Daphne's sleeper berth on the train.
facts.why: The party is called as 'Party in upper 7', Daphne's berth, and it runs late at night on the train.

facts.text: The midnight party in Daphne's upper berth.
facts.why: The late-night party is in upper 7, Daphne's berth, with Sugar climbing in and the crowd bringing food and drink.

vibe.verdict: Grand hotel dining room with the right names and a good Scotch in a coffee cup joke, but the yacht and berth lines are unconfirmed.
